title: Hearty German Sun Dried Tomato Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful stew featuring sun-dried tomatoes, perfect for a sick day, made with Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients and served in an earthenware bowl.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large earthenware bowl over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cubed potatoes, chopped sun-dried tomatoes, vegetable broth, tomato paste, chopped parsley, and chopped thyme to the bowl.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, if desired.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
